key: CULTIST 1: Hello! Did you just come through Heaven's Gate?!
en: CULTIST 1: Hello! Did you just come through Heaven's Gate?!
ja: 信徒1: こんにちは! あなた、今「天の門」を通ってきたの!?

key: Are you an envoy of the gods, or the agent of this chaos?!
en: Are you an envoy of the gods, or the agent of this chaos?!
ja: あなたは神々の使者、それともこのこんとんの手先!?

key: CULTIST 2: They don't look like an "envoy of the gods" to me...
en: CULTIST 2: They don't look like an "envoy of the gods" to me...
ja: 信徒2: あたしには「神々の使者」には見えないけど……

key: CULTIST 1: Then we have no choice but to detain you for defiling this sacred space!
en: CULTIST 1: Then we have no choice but to detain you for defiling this sacred space!
ja: 信徒1: それなら、この神聖な場所を汚した罪で拘束するしかないわね!

key: An agent of chaos indeed!
en: An agent of chaos indeed!
ja: まさしくこんとんの手先ね!

key: You will endure allegiance to the Lord or you will return from whence you came!
en: You will endure allegiance to the Lord or you will return from whence you came!
ja: 主への忠誠を誓うか、来た道を戻るか、どちらかにしてもらうぞ!

key: CULTIST 1: ...
en: CULTIST 1: ...

key: Well you don't LOOK like a divine envoy.
en: Well you don't LOOK like a divine envoy.
ja: まあ、神の使者には見えないわね。

key: Lord Solaris will want to see you for questioning.
en: Lord Solaris will want to see you for questioning.
ja: ソラリス様が、あなたに話を聞きたいと仰るはずよ。

key: CULTIST 2: But how can we subdue this threat?
en: CULTIST 2: But how can we subdue this threat?
ja: 信徒2: でも、この脅威をどうやって抑え込む?

key: CULTIST 1: Ah, the hand-grenade!
en: CULTIST 1: Ah, the hand-grenade!
ja: 信徒1: ああ、あの手りゅう弾よ!

key: CULTIST 2: Of course! The Holy Hand Grenade of Antidote!
en: CULTIST 2: Of course! The Holy Hand Grenade of Antidote!
ja: 信徒2: そうか! 解毒の聖なる手りゅう弾!

key: Any agent of chaos will be blown away; any envoy unharmed!
en: Any agent of chaos will be blown away; any envoy unharmed!
ja: こんとんの手先なら吹き飛ばされ、使者なら無傷で済むはずだ!

key: Use it at once!
en: Use it at once!
ja: 今すぐ使うんだ!

key: CULTIST: 1...
en: CULTIST: 1...

key: ???: ...Did you see them?
en: ???: ...Did you see them?

key: ???: Not from here...
en: ???: Not from here...
ja: ???: ここからじゃ見えないよ……

key: Shouldn't we be quiet?
en: Shouldn't we be quiet?
ja: 静かにしてなきゃダメじゃない?

key: If Dad hears us...
en: If Dad hears us...
ja: パパに聞かれたら……

key: ???: It'll be okay, he can't even get to us right now!
en: ???: It'll be okay, he can't even get to us right now!
ja: ???: 大丈夫だって、今はこっちに来られないんだから!

key: Psst, hey, person!
en: Psst, hey, person!
ja: ねえねえ、そこの人!

key: Mystery person!
en: Mystery person!
ja: なぞの人!

key: Can you hear me?
en: Can you hear me?
ja: 聞こえてる?

key: ???: Yeah, see?
en: ???: Yeah, see?
ja: ???: うん、ほらね?

key: It's fine, they're friendly.
en: It's fine, they're friendly.
ja: 大丈夫だよ、この人優しいから。

key: Well, maybe.
en: Well, maybe.
ja: まあ、たぶんね。

key: ???: Liar!
en: ???: Liar!
ja: ???: うそつき!

key: If you can't hear me then how did you know to say "No," huh?!
en: If you can't hear me then how did you know to say "No," huh?!
ja: 聞こえてないなら、なんで「たぶん」なんて言えるのさ!?

key: ???: That doesn't even make sense!
en: ???: That doesn't even make sense!
ja: ???: それ、意味分かんないよ!

key: Now you're just being silly!
en: Now you're just being silly!
ja: もう、バカなこと言って!

key: What's your name?
en: What's your name?
ja: あなた、名前は?

key: Mine is Lukah!
en: Mine is Lukah!
ja: あたしはルカ!

key: ???: Hey, you really should probably stop...
en: ???: Hey, you really should probably stop...
ja: ???: ねえ、いい加減やめた方が……

key: LUKAH: And the worry-wart over there...
en: LUKAH: And the worry-wart over there...
ja: ルカ: それであっちの心配性さんは……

key: That's Taka!
en: That's Taka!
ja: タカだよ!

key: He's my master, so I'm supposed to serve him until the day I die!
en: He's my master, so I'm supposed to serve him until the day I die!
ja: あたしのご主人様だから、死ぬまでずっとお仕えするんだ!

key: TAKA: Lukah, please don't say things like that...
en: TAKA: Lukah, please don't say things like that...
ja: タカ: ルカ、そういうこと言わないでくれよ……

key: LUKAH: Why? It's just true.
en: LUKAH: Why? It's just true.
ja: ルカ: どうして? 本当のことだもん。

key: There's nothing wrong with it.
en: There's nothing wrong with it.
ja: 何もおかしくないよ。

key: If anything, I'm grateful that my life has a clear purpose.
en: If anything, I'm grateful that my life has a clear purpose.
ja: むしろ、自分の人生にはっきりした目的があるって、感謝してるくらい。

key: TAKA: Ugh...
en: TAKA: Ugh...
ja: タカ: うぅ……

key: LUKAH: So, why are you in here?
en: LUKAH: So, why are you in here?
ja: ルカ: それで、なんでここにいるの?

key: Our Dads put us in here because we're onto their tricks!
en: Our Dads put us in here because we're onto their tricks!
ja: パパたちの企みに気づいちゃったから、ここに閉じ込められたの!

key: We kept feeling around and messing with the statues and then we got time out together!
en: We kept feeling around and messing with the statues and then we got time out together!
ja: 像をあちこち触って回ってたら、二人一緒にお仕置き部屋行きになっちゃって!

key: Well, sort-of together!
en: Well, sort-of together!
ja: まあ、一応一緒ってことで!

key: But if you think about it, there HAS to be secret passages!
en: But if you think about it, there HAS to be secret passages!
ja: でもよく考えたら、絶対に隠し通路があるはずなんだよ!

key: The hallway suddenly changed!
en: The hallway suddenly changed!
ja: 廊下が急に変わったし!

key: There's no other explanation.
en: There's no other explanation.
ja: それしか説明がつかないもん。

key: Also, why WOULDN'T there be secret passages?
en: Also, why WOULDN'T there be secret passages?
ja: それに、隠し通路がないなんて、そっちの方がおかしいよ?

key: When I'm an adult, I want to live in a castle that ONLY has secret passages.
en: When I'm an adult, I want to live in a castle that ONLY has secret passages.
ja: 大人になったら、隠し通路しかないお城に住みたいな。

key: I think all adults should have secret passages.
en: I think all adults should have secret passages.
ja: 大人はみんな隠し通路を持つべきだと思うんだ。

key: So I'm sure there are some here.
en: So I'm sure there are some here.
ja: だから、ここにも絶対あるはず。

key: TAKA: Lukah, please, what if it's a bad guy?
en: TAKA: Lukah, please, what if it's a bad guy?
ja: タカ: ルカ、頼むよ、もし悪い人だったらどうするんだ?

key: LUKAH: Then I'll protect you.
en: LUKAH: Then I'll protect you.
ja: ルカ: そのときはあたしが守るよ。

key: But what if it's not?
en: But what if it's not?
ja: でも、そうじゃなかったら?

key: The only way to find out is to find out!
en: The only way to find out is to find out!
ja: それを確かめる方法は、確かめてみることだけだよ!

key: And then you don't have to be scared of them!
en: And then you don't have to be scared of them!
ja: そうすれば、怖がる必要もなくなるし!

key: So let me find out and protect you, Young Master.
en: So let me find out and protect you, Young Master.
ja: だから、あたしに確かめさせて、若様のことは守ってあげる。

key: So, are you a bad guy?
en: So, are you a bad guy?
ja: それで、あなたは悪い人?

key: LUKAH: Hmmmmmmmmmmm...
en: LUKAH: Hmmmmmmmmmmm...
ja: ルカ: うーーーーーん……

key: But would a bad guy admit to being bad?
en: But would a bad guy admit to being bad?
ja: でも、悪い人が自分から「悪い」って認めるかな?

key: Bad guys usually think they're the good guys, right?
en: Bad guys usually think they're the good guys, right?
ja: 悪い人ってたいてい、自分は良い人だと思ってるものでしょ?

key: So if you're saying you ARE bad...
en: So if you're saying you ARE bad...
ja: だから、あなたが「悪い」って言うってことは……

key: That must mean that you're NOT bad!
en: That must mean that you're NOT bad!
ja: きっと悪い人じゃないってことだよ!

key: LUKAH: Hmmm...
en: LUKAH: Hmmm...
ja: ルカ: うーん……

key: Yep, I believe you!
en: Yep, I believe you!
ja: うん、信じるよ!

key: Then it's settled!
en: Then it's settled!
ja: それで決まりだね!

key: TAKA: Nothing is settled, Lukah!
en: TAKA: Nothing is settled, Lukah!
ja: タカ: 何も決まってないよ、ルカ!

key: Look, please just be quiet.
en: Look, please just be quiet.
ja: とにかく、静かにしててくれよ。

key: Someone will come to get us soon...
en: Someone will come to get us soon...
ja: すぐに誰か迎えに来るから……

key: LUKAH: ...Well, if that's an order...
en: LUKAH: ...Well, if that's an order...
ja: ルカ: ……まあ、命令ならしょうがないか……

key: Okay.
en: Okay.
ja: 分かった。

key: TAKA: U-um, how did you get in here?!
en: TAKA: U-um, how did you get in here?!
ja: タカ: え、えっと、どうやってここに入ってきたんだ!?

key: You ARE a bad guy, aren't you!?
en: You ARE a bad guy, aren't you!?
ja: やっぱり悪い人なんだろ!?

key: Danger of strangers!
en: Danger of strangers!
ja: 見知らぬ人は危険だ!

key: LUKAH: Huh?! How'd you get in here?!
en: LUKAH: Huh?! How'd you get in here?!
ja: ルカ: え!? どうやって入ってきたの!?

key: TAKA: Lukah? What's happened?
en: TAKA: Lukah? What's happened?
ja: タカ: ルカ? 何が起きたんだ?

key: LUKAH: Wait, is it the statue? Did Arceus give you this power?
en: LUKAH: Wait, is it the statue? Did Arceus give you this power?
ja: ルカ: あ、もしかして像のせい? アルセウスがその力をくれたの?

key: Let me try!
en: Let me try!
ja: あたしもやってみる!

key: LUKAH: Oh!
en: LUKAH: Oh!
ja: ルカ: あ!

key: LUKAH: All free!
en: LUKAH: All free!
ja: ルカ: 自由だ!

key: TAKA: Wait, waitwaitwait, what just happened?!
en: TAKA: Wait, waitwaitwait, what just happened?!
ja: タカ: 待って、待って待って、今何が起きたんだ!?

key: LUKAH: This person showed me how to rescue you!
en: LUKAH: This person showed me how to rescue you!
ja: ルカ: この人が、若様を助ける方法を教えてくれたの!

key: I knew they were good!
en: I knew they were good!
ja: やっぱり良い人だと思った!

key: TAKA: But how did...
en: TAKA: But how did...
ja: タカ: でも、どうやって……

key: LUKAH: Oh, the wall on the inside is full of dirt and bugs!
en: LUKAH: Oh, the wall on the inside is full of dirt and bugs!
ja: ルカ: あ、壁の内側、土と虫だらけだ!

key: Gross!
en: Gross!
ja: きたなーい!

key: TAKA: Ew...
en: TAKA: Ew...
ja: タカ: うわ……

key: Lukah, get out of there...
en: Lukah, get out of there...
ja: ルカ、そこから出てきてくれよ……

key: I don't think I want to be here anymore if it's like that...
en: I don't think I want to be here anymore if it's like that...
ja: そんな感じなら、もうここにいたくないんだけど……

key: LUKAH: No worries! It's not just this place-- I heard every building is like that!
en: LUKAH: No worries! It's not just this place-- I heard every building is like that!
ja: ルカ: 大丈夫だよ! ここだけじゃなくて、どの建物もこんな感じらしいから!

key: TAKA: ...
en: TAKA: ...
ja: タカ: ……

key: LUKAH: Besides, there's no reason to be afraid of what's there now that we know what it is!
en: LUKAH: Besides, there's no reason to be afraid of what's there now that we know what it is!
ja: ルカ: それに、もう正体が分かったんだから、怖がる理由なんてないよ!

key: It seems like we just walk through all of it with the statue's blessing anyway.
en: It seems like we just walk through all of it with the statue's blessing anyway.
ja: どうせ像の加護があれば、全部平気で通り抜けられるみたいだし。

key: Oh, Young Master, your necktie is loose.
en: Oh, Young Master, your necktie is loose.
ja: あ、若様、ネクタイ緩んでる。

key: Here, let me get that for you!
en: Here, let me get that for you!
ja: ほら、直してあげる!

key: TAKA: Lukah, please... I already said not to call me that.
en: TAKA: Lukah, please... I already said not to call me that.
ja: タカ: ルカ、頼むから……その呼び方はやめてって言っただろ。

key: LUKAH: But I have to.
en: LUKAH: But I have to.
ja: ルカ: でも、そう呼ばなきゃ。

key: I don't mind; I think it suits you!
en: I don't mind; I think it suits you!
ja: あたしは気にしないし、若様には似合ってると思うよ!

key: TAKA: Just what part of that suits me...
en: TAKA: Just what part of that suits me...
ja: タカ: いったいどこが似合ってるんだよ……

key: LUKAH: Anyway, isn't it weird?
en: LUKAH: Anyway, isn't it weird?
ja: ルカ: それにしても、変じゃない?

key: They don't usually do that-- the statues.
en: They don't usually do that-- the statues.
ja: 普段はあんなことしないよね――あの像。

key: I wonder if it's related to all the hallways changing shape?
en: I wonder if it's related to all the hallways changing shape?
ja: 廊下の形が変わってるのと、関係あるのかな?

key: TAKA: Father said there was some kind of power distorting the place...?
en: TAKA: Father said there was some kind of power distorting the place...?
ja: タカ: 父上が、何かの力がこの場所をゆがませてるって言ってたっけ……?

key: LUKAH: He's just saying that so we don't find out about the secret passages.
en: LUKAH: He's just saying that so we don't find out about the secret passages.
ja: ルカ: それ、隠し通路のことを知られないように、そう言ってるだけだよ。

key: You're all set, so let's go look for them!
en: You're all set, so let's go look for them!
ja: もう自由になったんだから、探しに行こうよ!

key: TAKA: Won't we just get in more trouble then?
en: TAKA: Won't we just get in more trouble then?
ja: タカ: それ、もっと怒られるだけじゃないか?

key: LUKAH: Nah, the adults have bigger concerns right now.
en: LUKAH: Nah, the adults have bigger concerns right now.
ja: ルカ: ううん、今の大人たちはそれどころじゃないから。

key: LUKAH: Oh, they locked us in.
en: LUKAH: Oh, they locked us in.
ja: ルカ: あ、鍵かけられてる。

key: Good thing I stole a key earlier!
en: Good thing I stole a key earlier!
ja: さっき鍵、盗んでおいてよかった!

key: TAKA: Lukah...
en: TAKA: Lukah...
ja: タカ: ルカ……

key: LUKAH: It's okay, Young Master. Even if we get in trouble, I'll be the one to take all the blame.
en: LUKAH: It's okay, Young Master. Even if we get in trouble, I'll be the one to take all the blame.
ja: ルカ: 大丈夫だよ、若様。怒られても、全部あたしが引き受けるから。

key: So please don't worry about it!
en: So please don't worry about it!
ja: だから何も気にしなくていいよ!

key: TAKA: That doesn't make me feel better...
en: TAKA: That doesn't make me feel better...
ja: タカ: それ、全然安心できないんだけど……

key: LUKAH: Door's open! Let's go!
en: LUKAH: Door's open! Let's go!
ja: ルカ: ドア開いた! 行こう!

key: TAKA: ...Lukah...
en: TAKA: ...Lukah...
ja: タカ: ……ルカ……

key: Um, well...
en: Um, well...
ja: あの、その……

key: Thanks for getting us out, I think.
en: Thanks for getting us out, I think.
ja: 助けてくれて、ありがとう、たぶん。

key: I don't know why they put you in here, but...
en: I don't know why they put you in here, but...
ja: なんであなたがここに入れられたのかは知らないけど……

key: If you're like the last lady, it probably wasn't your fault, right?
en: If you're like the last lady, it probably wasn't your fault, right?
ja: 前のお姉さんと同じなら、たぶんあなたのせいじゃないんだよね?

key: Um, so if you want to escape...
en: Um, so if you want to escape...
ja: あの、それで、もし逃げたいなら……

key: There are four switches you need to find-- one for each color.
en: There are four switches you need to find-- one for each color.
ja: 見つけなきゃいけないスイッチが4つあるんだ――色ごとに一つずつ。

key: The hallways are kind of a mess, but I think I saw one of the switches very nearby...
en: The hallways are kind of a mess, but I think I saw one of the switches very nearby...
ja: 廊下はぐちゃぐちゃになってるけど、すぐ近くにスイッチが一つあったと思う……

key: And then you can get back to the surface.
en: And then you can get back to the surface.
ja: そうすれば、地上に戻れるはずだよ。

key: ...Don't tell anyone I told you that though, okay?
en: ...Don't tell anyone I told you that though, okay?
ja: ……でも、これ教えたって、誰にも言わないでね?

key: Um, okay.
en: Um, okay.
ja: あの、うん。

key: Bye.
en: Bye.
ja: じゃあね。

key: (Walk through walls in a limited space. Press A to return to the point of origin.)
en: (Walk through walls in a limited space. Press A to return to the point of origin.)
ja: （限られた空間で壁をすり抜けられる。Aボタンで元の場所に戻る。）

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: LUKAH: Hey, how'd you get out of there?!
en: LUKAH: Hey, how'd you get out of there?!
ja: ルカ: ねえ、そこからどうやって出てきたの!?

key: Wait, if you can get out of there, can you get IN here?
en: Wait, if you can get out of there, can you get IN here?
ja: ちょっと待って、そこから出られるなら、こっちに入ることもできる?

key: TAKA: O-oh, they didn't lock you up?
en: TAKA: O-oh, they didn't lock you up?
ja: タカ: え、あ、閉じ込められなかったのか?

key: The statue appears to have no more energy in it.
en: The statue appears to have no more energy in it.
ja: あの像は、もうエネルギーが残っていないようだ。

key: Is it you who is responsible for this distortion!?
en: Is it you who is responsible for this distortion!?
ja: このゆがみを引き起こしたのは、お前か!?

key: Let us pray this was not your doing...
en: Let us pray this was not your doing...
ja: お前の仕業でないことを祈ろう……

key: I trust there is a purpose for all this.
en: I trust there is a purpose for all this.
ja: これにはきっと意味があるはずだ。

key: For what purpose have you intruded on this place?
en: For what purpose have you intruded on this place?
ja: 何の目的があって、この場所に立ち入った?

key: For what purpose have I been punished?
en: For what purpose have I been punished?
ja: 何の目的があって、あたしは罰を受けているの?

key: For what purpose are we left here in this confusion...?
en: For what purpose are we left here in this confusion...?
ja: 何の目的があって、あたしたちはこの混乱の中に置き去りにされているの……?

key: Ah, do you know the way out?
en: Ah, do you know the way out?
ja: ああ、出口を知ってる?

key: Is that a 'no' then?
en: Is that a 'no' then?
ja: それは「いいえ」ってこと?

key: Maybe I shouldn't have taken that left turn at the Arceus statue...
en: Maybe I shouldn't have taken that left turn at the Arceus statue...
ja: アルセウス像のところで左に曲がるんじゃなかったかもしれないわね……

key: If I capture you, will I find truth?
en: If I capture you, will I find truth?
ja: あなたを捕まえれば、真実にたどり着けるのかしら?

key: Ah, I have only found defeat...
en: Ah, I have only found defeat...
ja: ああ、私が見つけたのは敗北だけだったか……

key: We are all always looking for something. Find it well.
en: We are all always looking for something. Find it well.
ja: 我らは皆、常に何かを探し求めている。よく見つけるがいい。

key: The Lord has led you to me.
en: The Lord has led you to me.
ja: 主が、お前を私のもとへと導いた。

key: And so the Lord shall lead you away.
en: And so the Lord shall lead you away.
ja: そして主は、お前を再び導き去るであろう。

key: Every word we speak is scripted by His design.
en: Every word we speak is scripted by His design.
ja: 我らの語る言葉は、すべて主の意志によって定められている。

key: Speak with pride.
en: Speak with pride.
ja: 誇りを持って語るがいい。

key: SOLARIS: Just where have you been?
en: SOLARIS: Just where have you been?
ja: ソラリス: 一体どこに行っていた?

key: TAKA: Um... Lukah and I were just playing.
en: TAKA: Um... Lukah and I were just playing.
ja: タカ: あの……ルカと、ちょっと遊んでただけで。

key: SOLARIS: Right.
en: SOLARIS: Right.
ja: ソラリス: そうか。

key: I trust you've finished your studies already, then?
en: I trust you've finished your studies already, then?
ja: ならばもちろん、勉強はもう終わらせたのだろうな?

key: TAKA: Um... Mostly.
en: TAKA: Um... Mostly.
ja: タカ: あの……だいたいは。

key: SOLARIS: Mostly?
en: SOLARIS: Mostly?
ja: ソラリス: だいたい、だと?

key: This is a binary answer, Taka.
en: This is a binary answer, Taka.
ja: これは二択の質問だぞ、タカ。

key: You either have finished them or you have not finished them.
en: You either have finished them or you have not finished them.
ja: 終わらせたか、終わらせていないか、どちらかだ。

key: Which is it?
en: Which is it?
ja: どちらだ?

key: TAKA: I... guess I haven't finished them.
en: TAKA: I... guess I haven't finished them.
ja: タカ: た、たぶん……終わらせていないと思います。

key: SOLARIS: Why do you have need to guess?
en: SOLARIS: Why do you have need to guess?
ja: ソラリス: なぜ「思う」などと推測する必要がある?

key: Are you unsure if you have or not?
en: Are you unsure if you have or not?
ja: 終わらせたかどうかも分からないのか?

key: Look me in the eyes when I'm speaking to you.
en: Look me in the eyes when I'm speaking to you.
ja: 私が話している間は、目を見なさい。

key: Are your expectations unclear?
en: Are your expectations unclear?
ja: お前への期待が、分かっていないのか?

key: TAKA: N-no, Father.
en: TAKA: N-no, Father.
ja: タカ: い、いえ、父上。

key: SOLARIS: So then do you "guess" to hide your guilt with trifles, or for what reason do you communicate with such ambiguity?
en: SOLARIS: So then do you "guess" to hide your guilt with trifles, or for what reason do you communicate with such ambiguity?
ja: ソラリス: では、ささいなことで罪悪感を誤魔化そうと「思う」などと言うのか、それとも他に何か理由があって、そのように曖昧な話し方をするのか?

key: TAKA: I'm-- sorry.
en: TAKA: I'm-- sorry.
ja: タカ: す、すみません。

key: SOLARIS: That is not an answer to the question.
en: SOLARIS: That is not an answer to the question.
ja: ソラリス: それは質問の答えになっていない。

key: TAKA: I was... just trying to hide it.
en: TAKA: I was... just trying to hide it.
ja: タカ: ただ……誤魔化そうとしてました。

key: SOLARIS: Dishonesty is a tool of the weak.
en: SOLARIS: Dishonesty is a tool of the weak.
ja: ソラリス: 不誠実さとは、弱者の道具だ。

key: Do not fool yourself into believing you are weak.
en: Do not fool yourself into believing you are weak.
ja: 自分が弱者であると思い込むな。

key: You are a scion.
en: You are a scion.
ja: お前は我が一族の跡継ぎだ。

key: You do not have the luxury of weakness; of guessing.
en: You do not have the luxury of weakness; of guessing.
ja: 弱さも、推測に頼ることも、お前には許されていない。

key: The future weighs on your shoulders.
en: The future weighs on your shoulders.
ja: 未来はお前の肩にかかっている。

key: You must rise to meet it.
en: You must rise to meet it.
ja: それにふさわしい者にならねばならん。

key: This begins with your studies.
en: This begins with your studies.
ja: それはまず、勉学から始まる。

key: Am I understood?
en: Am I understood?
ja: 分かったか?

key: TAKA: Y-yeah...
en: TAKA: Y-yeah...
ja: タカ: は、はい……

key: SOLARIS: "Yes, Father."
en: SOLARIS: "Yes, Father."
ja: ソラリス: 「はい、父上」だ。

key: TAKA: Yes, Father.
en: TAKA: Yes, Father.
ja: タカ: はい、父上。

key: SOLARIS: You must be more assertive.
en: SOLARIS: You must be more assertive.
ja: ソラリス: もっとはっきりとものを言え。

key: No one will take you seriously if you stammer and stumble through every sentence.
en: No one will take you seriously if you stammer and stumble through every sentence.
ja: 一言一言つっかえて口ごもっていては、誰にも真剣に受け止めてもらえん。

key: I am sure I have told you this before.
en: I am sure I have told you this before.
ja: 前にも言ったはずだ。

key: I do not wish to have this talk again.
en: I do not wish to have this talk again.
ja: この話を、また繰り返したくはない。

key: I will ask again-- am I clear?
en: I will ask again-- am I clear?
ja: もう一度聞く――分かったか?

key: SOLARIS: ...
en: SOLARIS: ...
ja: ソラリス: ……

key: Fine. You are dismissed.
en: Fine. You are dismissed.
ja: よろしい。下がってよい。

key: See to it you complete your studies properly before engaging in frivolousness.
en: See to it you complete your studies properly before engaging in frivolousness.
ja: くだらないことに興じる前に、きちんと勉学を終わらせておけ。

key: ELIAS: I see you've been let out.
en: ELIAS: I see you've been let out.
ja: イライアス: 出してもらえたようだな。

key: LUKAH: Yeah...
en: LUKAH: Yeah...
ja: ルカ: うん……

key: ELIAS: What is the purpose of a time-out if you can simply end it as you please?
en: ELIAS: What is the purpose of a time-out if you can simply end it as you please?
ja: イライアス: 自分の好きなときに終わらせられるのなら、お仕置きに何の意味がある?

key: LUKAH: It's to allow us time to reflect on our actions and the reasons they may have been a problem.
en: LUKAH: It's to allow us time to reflect on our actions and the reasons they may have been a problem.
ja: ルカ: 自分のやったことと、それが何で問題だったのかを、じっくり反省するための時間、だよね。

key: And I was done reflecting.
en: And I was done reflecting.
ja: それで、あたしはもう反省し終わってたの。

key: I understand that I could've been in Lord Solaris's way, or caused damage to a priceless statue if I was careless.
en: I understand that I could've been in Lord Solaris's way, or caused damage to a priceless statue if I was careless.
ja: ソラリス様の邪魔になったり、不注意で貴重な像を傷つけたりする可能性があったって、ちゃんと分かってる。

key: The young master understood that as well, and we were both very sorry, so one of the others let us go.
en: The young master understood that as well, and we were both very sorry, so one of the others let us go.
ja: 若様もちゃんと分かってくれてたし、二人ともすごく反省してたから、他の人が出してくれたの。

key: ELIAS: ...Indeed.
en: ELIAS: ...Indeed.
ja: イライアス: ……そうか。

key: I suppose that is adequate.
en: I suppose that is adequate.
ja: それなら十分だろう。

key: I hope you understand it brings me no joy to have to punish either you or the young master.
en: I hope you understand it brings me no joy to have to punish either you or the young master.
ja: お前や若様を罰することに、私は何の喜びも感じていないと、分かってほしい。

key: There are simply things that must be learned, and in the midst of this distortion, we hadn't the time to deal with your antics as well.
en: There are simply things that must be learned, and in the midst of this distortion, we hadn't the time to deal with your antics as well.
ja: ただ、学ばねばならないことがあるというだけだ。それに、このゆがみの最中に、お前たちのいたずらにまで構っている暇はなかった。

key: LUKAH: I get it.
en: LUKAH: I get it.
ja: ルカ: 分かってる。

key: ELIAS: Just as well.
en: ELIAS: Just as well.
ja: イライアス: それでいい。

key: I am grateful the Lord saw fit to grace you with maturity far exceeding your age.
en: I am grateful the Lord saw fit to grace you with maturity far exceeding your age.
ja: 主がお前に、年齢を超えた成熟を与えてくださったこと、感謝している。

key: I pray it serves the young master well.
en: I pray it serves the young master well.
ja: それが若様のためになることを祈るばかりだ。

key: LUKAH: I'll do my best for him too!
en: LUKAH: I'll do my best for him too!
ja: ルカ: 若様のためにも、精一杯頑張るよ!

key: ELIAS: That is an admirable spirit for one of our family to have.
en: ELIAS: That is an admirable spirit for one of our family to have.
ja: イライアス: それこそ、我が一族の者にふさわしい心構えだ。

key: You will be a fitting servant and companion for him-- far better than I was for my own charge.
en: You will be a fitting servant and companion for him-- far better than I was for my own charge.
ja: お前は、若様にとってふさわしい従者、そして仲間になるだろう――私が仕えた主人に対して果たせた以上にな。

key: Every day, you bring a light I never dared hope for.
en: Every day, you bring a light I never dared hope for.
ja: お前は日々、私が期待すらできなかった光をもたらしてくれる。

key: I am proud to be able to call you my son.
en: I am proud to be able to call you my son.
ja: お前を我が子と呼べることを、誇りに思う。

key: LUKAH: ...Soooo, is this whole moving distorted space thing an act of the Lord too, or...?
en: LUKAH: ...Soooo, is this whole moving distorted space thing an act of the Lord too, or...?
ja: ルカ: ……それでさ、この動くゆがんだ空間ってやつも、主様のなさったことなの、それとも……?

key: ELIAS: We do not believe so.
en: ELIAS: We do not believe so.
ja: イライアス: そうではないと考えている。

key: One of the acolytes reports having seen a Palkia in the main chamber.
en: One of the acolytes reports having seen a Palkia in the main chamber.
ja: 従者の一人が、本殿でパルキアを見たと報告してきた。

key: But just how that came to be here may be nothing short of a miracle yet...
en: But just how that came to be here may be nothing short of a miracle yet...
ja: だが、それがどうしてここに現れたのかは、まさに奇跡としか言いようがないだろう……

key: LUKAH: A Palkia? What's that?
en: LUKAH: A Palkia? What's that?
ja: ルカ: パルキアって何?

key: ELIAS: There's little time to explain.
en: ELIAS: There's little time to explain.
ja: イライアス: 説明している時間はあまりない。

key: Walk with me; I will tell you as we go.
en: Walk with me; I will tell you as we go.
ja: 一緒に歩きながら話そう。

key: PALKIA: Praaaaaak!
en: PALKIA: Praaaaaak!
ja: パルキア: プラアアアク!

key: Kyaaa!
en: Kyaaa!
ja: キャアア!

key: PALKIA: Kiiaaaa!
en: PALKIA: Kiiaaaa!
ja: パルキア: キィアアア!

key: The statue appears to be inactive now.
en: The statue appears to be inactive now.
ja: あの像は、今はもう活動していないようだ。

key: DIALGA: Diiiiia~
en: DIALGA: Diiiiia~
ja: ディアルガ: ディーィア〜

key: Gaaaah!
en: Gaaaah!
ja: ガアアア!

key: DIALGA: Yaaaaaaria~
en: DIALGA: Yaaaaaaria~
ja: ディアルガ: ヤアアアリア〜

key: ANNA: --e'S waiting--
en: ANNA: --e'S waiting--
ja: アンナ: ――アイツが待ってる――

key: Now, it's nOw!
en: Now, it's nOw!
ja: 今よ、今しかない!

key: The boY with the bRoken wIng--
en: The boY with the bRoken wIng--
ja: 折れた翼を持つ少年――

key: All we neEd...
en: All we neEd...
ja: 必要なのは……

key: ...is a sEcond chAnce!
en: ...is a sEcond chAnce!
ja: ……もう一度のチャンスだけ!

key: Skip sanctum puzzle?
en: Skip sanctum puzzle?
ja: 聖域のパズルをスキップしますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
